name: AgentDeck
tagline: One dashboard for all your coding agent sessions
description: AgentDeck shows every Claude Code, Codex and Cursor agent session in one place: status, branch, last message and cost. Resume, archive and search transcripts.
comment_samples: Finally! I was doing this with tmux and a spreadsheet.
Great start but it only works with Claude Code, my Codex sessions don't show up.
Cost tracking is per session, I need it per project.
Mac only? I'm on Linux most of the day.
Would love persistent memory per project, right now each session still starts cold.

name: Worktree Pilot
tagline: Run parallel AI agents in isolated git worktrees
description: Spin up isolated worktrees per task, launch an agent in each, and review the resulting branches side by side.
comment_samples: Love the worktree isolation.
Setup is fiddly and it broke on a monorepo.
No way to see what a session is waiting on, I still tab through terminals.
Pricing is steep for a solo dev.

name: ContextVault
tagline: Persistent memory for AI coding assistants
description: Stores architectural decisions, conventions and project context and injects them into any agent session.
comment_samples: Exactly the problem I have.
The memory gets stale and there's no easy way to edit it.
Doesn't help with multiple concurrent sessions.
Integration required a custom MCP server which took an afternoon.

name: Swarm Console
description: Enterprise console for teams running fleets of coding agents with approvals, audit logs and SSO.
comment_samples: Looks powerful but clearly aimed at large teams.
Requested a demo, minimum contract is annual.
Overkill for my two-person startup.

name: Sessionly
tagline: Never lose an AI coding session again
description: Automatic checkpoints and one-click resume for terminal-based coding agents.
comment_samples: Simple and does one thing.
Only supports one agent at a time so far.

name: SoloLedger
tagline: Time tracking, invoicing and reminders for one-person businesses
description: Track time, turn it into invoices and automatically chase late payers. Built for freelancers, not agencies.
comment_samples: Replaced three tools for me.
No proposal or contract step, so I still re-type client details.
Reminder emails are great but can't be customised per client.
Wish it imported from Toggl.

name: InvoiceNudge
tagline: Polite, automatic follow-ups for unpaid invoices
description: Connects to Stripe, QuickBooks and Wave and sends escalating reminders on a schedule you control.
comment_samples: Got paid 9 days faster on average.
Only does reminders, nothing upstream.
Free tier is 3 invoices which is nothing.

name: ClientLoop Suite
tagline: Proposals, contracts, invoices and CRM for agencies
description: All-in-one client management for creative agencies: pipeline, proposals, e-sign, invoicing, team time tracking.
comment_samples: Powerful but I use 20% of it.
$59/month is hard to justify as a solo freelancer.
Onboarding took me a full weekend.
Great for our 8-person studio.

name: ReportRobot
tagline: Automated monthly client reports for marketers
description: Pulls data from ad platforms and analytics, writes a summary, and emails branded reports to clients.
comment_samples: Saves me a day a month.
Summaries are generic, I rewrite half of them.
Pricing per client adds up fast.

name: RemindRight
tagline: Appointment reminders that come from your own number
description: Two-way SMS reminders for salons, clinics and trades. Syncs with Google Calendar and popular booking tools.
comment_samples: No-shows down 40% in a month.
Doesn't do review requests, so I still need another tool.
Setup was easy, pricing is fair for one location.

name: FlowKit Pro
tagline: No-code automation builder for growing teams
description: Connect 3,000+ apps with drag-and-drop workflows, conditional logic and AI steps.
comment_samples: Incredibly flexible.
Too complicated for my shop, I gave up.
Free tier limits are tight and it gets expensive quickly.
Every workflow breaks when an app changes its API.

name: ReviewRocket
tagline: Get more Google reviews on autopilot
description: Sends review requests after each job or visit, with smart timing and follow-up.
comment_samples: Doubled our reviews.
Only reviews though, reminders would be the obvious add-on.
Minimum plan is for 3 locations, I have one.

name: StockSense
description: Multi-location restaurant inventory with par levels, supplier ordering and waste tracking.
comment_samples: Great for our three locations.
Way too much for a single cafe.
Needs a manager to maintain par levels.

name: QuoteOnSite
tagline: Build and send quotes from your phone
description: Field-first quoting for trades: templates, photos, e-sign and automatic follow-ups.
comment_samples: Exactly what I needed for landscaping.
Follow-ups are email only, my customers live on text.
iOS only for now.

name: PixelPal Wallpapers
tagline: Daily AI-generated wallpapers for your desktop
description: A new wallpaper every morning, generated from your mood.
comment_samples: So pretty!
Would love more styles.

name: Meditune
tagline: Guided meditations tuned to your heart rate
description: Uses your watch data to adapt breathing sessions in real time.
comment_samples: Very calming.
Battery drain is noticeable.
